query_paths.path_1_clinical_pubmed_query: "nintedanib" AND "ovarian" AND (biomarker OR FAP OR stroma OR fibroblast)
query_paths.path_2_geo_arrayexpress_query: "nintedanib" AND "ovarian" AND (fibroblast OR stroma OR CAF)

fap_reduction_magnitude: Dose-dependent reduction of FAP protein in TGF-β1–stimulated NIH-3T3 fibroblasts treated with nintedanib (immunoblot; multiple concentrations including 0.5–1 μM). Also reduced tumor FAP+ fibroblast burden in vivo (flow cytometry / immunoblot) in a mouse B16-F10 model.
notes: AGO-OVAR 12 / LUME-Ovar 1 primary trial PMID 26590673: no public FAP/CAF tissue biomarker reporting located in secondary translational outputs from this query path.
PMID 33246006 (FGFR upregulation / nintedanib in ovarian cancer context): did not report FAP or CAF marker quantification in the inspected abstract/full-text checks from earlier pass.
This is strong evidence that nintedanib can suppress FAP/CAF activation biology, but it is not HGSOC patient-tissue evidence.
